fr_html:
Le PRESIDENT, en remerciant Lord Phil-
limore de s'être rallié au texte de son avant-
projet, déclare accepter la modification demandée.
en_html:
The PRESIDENT thanked Lord Philli-
more for having accepted the text of his plan
and stated that he agreed to the required altera-
tions.
